column1: # Golden vectors for the Nikon monitor text, the media status and the remaining-time estimate,
# `RecordDurationEstimator`); Kotlin re-implements them in `Android/nikon` under the same names.
# Nothing links the two, so `NikonMonitorTextVectorTests` (Swift) and `NikonMonitorTextVectorTest`
# (Kotlin) both read this file and a rule edited on one side only fails a test.
# Rows (tab separated; "-" is an absent value):
#   media        <free bytes>  <total bytes>  <camera codec>  <WxH>  <fps>  <capacity label>  <duration label>
#                MediaStatus from a storage readback; "-" labels when the readback has no usable capacity
